notes.title: DLC CHAPTER 5 NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
The final chapter of ♡beAt! Another Season Episode is now available! You can unlock chapter 5 by finishing chapter 4.
The story of chapter 5 will be focusing on the protagonist Saku Mochidzuki and the new characters Oui Kokona and Riko Mikawa. Your choice during the game will lead you to a separate route for each character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/45ada9c8f2e53c992807503117cc0b3948c4e19c.png[/img]

After you finished chapter 5 you may unlock two new buttons on the dlc menu: 'PRODUCE MODE' and 'FAN MEETING'. In produce mode, you will become a new idol joining Yotsuba Production and your goal is to be the winner of the upcoming Idol Season Festival, which includes an original system of game play and will have multiple endings depending on the result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/4f5ffdc9dac5ee9900d5663a14f49c7784af1921.png[/img]

In fan meetings you will be able to have an One-on-one communication mode with the dlc characters Oui Kokona and Riko Mikawa. You may also challenge the idols using the new combat system this update added which is also the main feature of the Produce Mode.

This will be the final update for the ♡beAt! series. I'm proud of how far I made it and I hope you are also having as much fun as I am making this game by myself. It will be impossible without your support and thank you for playing & keep following the content. I wish you all the best and, see you next summer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/cc799a6c477fbd8b7abcb77468f1f283c1124e10.png[/img]

notes.title: DLC Chapter 5 preview & 2nd anniversary announcement
notes.content:
To celebrate the upcoming 2nd anniversary of the game and steam summer sale, I'm here to show some previews for the new chapter of the DLC Another Season Episode that I've been developing for a while!
Here's some screen shot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/45ada9c8f2e53c992807503117cc0b3948c4e19c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/675971634c5cb4f3da58514d385aa0c5a58880d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/4f5ffdc9dac5ee9900d5663a14f49c7784af1921.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/90ddbac3a49b91cfdd2c641ca66fab009a6f20f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/607880e1ef52e7410ff448aa8c36378a1949c7a8.png[/img]

Next update will include a new feature for both chapter 5 and the One-on-one communication mode. Basically you can play a minigame to compete for the score with other idols.
This also will be the main feature in the new "Produce mode '' in which the player will be a new idol joining Yotsuba Production and try to win for the upcoming ISF(Idol Season Festival).

Chapter 5 will be the final chapter for the DLC, and I'll be focused on the next project 「[url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/hicked]Hicked[/url]」. So hope you'll enjoy it and thank you for all the support through the past two years.
And finally, there'll be a theme song for the ♡beAt! series coming up next month!
[previewyoutube=UpRMW1vDfbs;full][/previewyoutube]

And again, thank you for all the support and stay tuned for the next update and maybe more!
Have a nice summer♡

notes.title: What's coming next? New chapter, new logo and more!
notes.content:
Thank you for following 《♡beAt!》 series. I'm glad to say that 《♡beAt! -After the Summer-》 has been released for a year by this point, and here's some new info about the game & the DLC.

First, because of the DLC having more lines in the scenario, the next chapter of the DLC will be released during autumn or winter, depending on how long it takes to write.
However, here's a screenshot from chapter 4. (Before translating.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/6fcf4232a2c9b440272ae419243171bb4eac9e06.png[/img]

Chapter 4 is about Core Hato, who is known as the main heroine of ♡beAt!, and the story will be about her life overseas before returning to Japan. Also there will be some more context about Oui Kokona, the new member and have more details of her background.

Next we have some announcement for the celebration of the game. A new video brought to you by Core Hato & Haru Samidare will be on the developer's channel at today's 8pm(UTC+9)
[previewyoutube=Wqn3uwVR3dw;full][/previewyoutube]
And also 《♡beAt! -After the Summer-》 is on STEAM Visual Novel Fest now! The game will be 39%off during the event, starting today until August 14th.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399182/22772cc0a122c63aa016264e8e56224a61315403.png[/img]
Also the series will have a brand new logo and a new promotion video for the celebration. you can watch it at:
[previewyoutube=ryHwhtAsKmc;full][/previewyoutube]

Again, thank you for following 《♡beAt!》 series. Hope you'd enjoy the content and hopefully will be looking forward to more updates.
